title: R2 vs B2 vs Garage — comparative research, clean accept

reasons: R2 and B2 pricing, free tiers, egress allowances, and Garage hardware/replication/ops requirements are well covered from official sources and satisfy several stage-1 criteria.
B2's exact S3 API parity is unverified, so the requirement that each option be characterized for missing or limited S3 features is not met.
Garage lacks a concrete homelab storage/TCO and egress/request cost model, so the all-three cost comparison required by stage 1 remains incomplete.
B2 operational limits and numeric availability SLA remain unfetched, leaving the reliability and operational comparison provisional.
All evidence is vendor-official; independent validation of integration with common homelab tooling is missing.
